title: Market Research Foundations Adventure
welcome_lead: You'll compare primary vs secondary research and meet the main data-gathering tools.
meta_desc: GCSE Business Studies market research foundations — primary vs secondary research methods.
final_note: You can distinguish primary from secondary research and list the main methods of each.

concepts.def: Gathering info on customers and the market
First-hand data collected by the firm itself
Data already collected by someone else
List of set questions to gather data
Small group discusses a product or topic

walkthroughs.body_html:
Primary data is collected first-hand — specific to your question.

Methods: questionnaires, interviews, observation, focus groups. Accurate but costly and slow.

Secondary data exists already — gov stats, news, industry reports, internet.

Cheap and fast but may be out of date or not perfectly relevant.

Start with secondary for the big picture, then use primary for specific gaps.

Most firms combine both to balance cost, speed and reliability.
